description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'RegexBasedAbstract' within the FastRoute library, responsible for generating data structures for route handling based on regex patterns. It manages static and variable routes, supports adding routes, and prepares route data for efficient matching.

classes.name: RegexBasedAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class providing a common implementation for data generators that rely on regex-based route definitions. It manages internal route trees and provides methods for adding routes, generating route data, and handling route regex building.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to the data generator, determining whether it is static or variable, and delegating to the appropriate internal method.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the current route data, including static routes and variable routes processed into chunks.

methods.name: generateVariableRouteData
methods.description: Generates route data for variable routes by chunking regex maps and processing each chunk.

methods.name: computeChunkSize
methods.description: Calculates appropriate chunk size for route processing based on the count and approximate chunk size.

methods.name: isStaticRoute
methods.description: Determines whether a route data array corresponds to a static route.

methods.name: addStaticRoute
methods.description: Adds a static route and checks for conflicts or shadowing routes.

methods.name: addVariableRoute
methods.description: Adds a variable route by building a regex pattern and creating a Route object.

methods.name: buildRegexForRoute
methods.description: Constructs a regex pattern from route parts, handling route variables and quoting static parts.

methods.name: regexHasCapturingGroups
methods.description: Detects if a regex pattern contains capturing groups to avoid regex conflicts.
